text:
Sea Limited grew revenue faster than Grab in both FY2024 and FY2025.

- **FY2024**: Sea's revenue grew 28.8% YoY, from US$13,063.6 million in 2023 to US$16,819.9 million in 2024 [Sea, FY2024, p.92]. Grab's revenue grew 18.6% YoY, from US$2,359 million in 2023 to US$2,797 million in 2024 [Grab, FY2024, p.128].
- **FY2025**: Sea's revenue grew 36.4% YoY, from US$16,819.9 million in 2024 to US$22,938.5 million in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.96]. Grab's revenue grew 20.5% YoY, from US$2,797 million in 2024 to US$3,370 million in 2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.88].

In both years, Sea's revenue growth rate (28.8% in FY2024, accelerating to 36.4% in FY2025) outpaced Grab's (18.6% in FY2024, rising to 20.5% in FY2025), making Sea the faster-growing company by revenue in both fiscal years.

answer:
Sea Limited grew revenue faster than Grab in both FY2024 and FY2025.

- **FY2024**: Sea's revenue grew 28.8% YoY, from US$13,063.6 million in 2023 to US$16,819.9 million in 2024 [Sea, FY2024, p.92]. Grab's revenue grew 18.6% YoY, from US$2,359 million in 2023 to US$2,797 million in 2024 [Grab, FY2024, p.128].
- **FY2025**: Sea's revenue grew 36.4% YoY, from US$16,819.9 million in 2024 to US$22,938.5 million in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.96]. Grab's revenue grew 20.5% YoY, from US$2,797 million in 2024 to US$3,370 million in 2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.88].

In both years, Sea's revenue growth rate (28.8% in FY2024, accelerating to 36.4% in FY2025) outpaced Grab's (18.6% in FY2024, rising to 20.5% in FY2025), making Sea the faster-growing company by revenue in both fiscal years.
